title: Incremental verification and gated experiments for pinned model revisions
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Provide a first-class workflow to safely promote new model revisions that are pinned to customer routes. This ticket defines a gated, incremental verification and A/B experiment capability that runs behind pins (i.e., the pin stays primary) so customers get deterministic behavior while Redwood collects quality and performance signals before recommending or auto-promoting a revision.

Motivation: Customers who pin to a model revision and then request upgrades want predictable behavior and guarded upgrades. Current pinned workflows either require manual testing or flip a pin abruptly—both risky for latency-sensitive product surfaces. We need a platform-level way to: (1) route a small percentage of live traffic to a candidate variant without changing the pining semantics, (2) run hidden A/B or shadow experiments to compare metrics, (3) evaluate against predefined quality prompt sets and synthetic/eval hooks, and (4) gate wider rollout or auto-promotion with clear rollback criteria.

Scope: This PM scope covers UX, acceptance criteria, high-level rollout strategy, required telemetry, success metrics, and handoff to eng/design. Implementation details (kernel selection, batching) live with ENG-4012. Design mocks reference DES-214.

Out of scope: full multi-tenant canary orchestration across regional clusters (follow-up), training/eval tooling beyond runtime-surface quality scoring, and billing model changes beyond token accounting reported in console.
acceptance_criteria: Console: PMs and engineers can create a 'pinned revision experiment' which attaches a candidate revision to an existing pin and configures traffic allocation (0.1% - 20%), evaluation prompt sets, and metric gates.
API: There is a new pin-level API to register candidate revisions and start/stop experiments via REST + SDKs without unpinning production traffic.

Telemetry: Experiment telemetry includes per-variant latency P50/P90/P99, error rates, cost-per-token, and a quality delta derived from a configurable eval prompt set; data is visible in the Console dashboard within 5 minutes.

Gating: Experiments support configurable pass/fail gates (absolute thresholds and delta thresholds) and a hard auto-rollback threshold for regressions that trigger immediate fallback to the pinned revision.
Audit + RBAC: All experiment actions (create/start/stop/promote/promote-auto) are recorded in audit logs and respect pin-level RBAC roles.
Docs: Public docs and a short runbook for handling failed experiments and manual promotion are published before full release.
Smoke tests: ENG provides end-to-end smoke tests that validate pinned experiments do not change pin-resolved outputs for non-experiment traffic.
Performance: Running an experiment on a medium-scale customer should not increase P95 tail latency for production traffic by more than 5% under normal load.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (canary engineering): Build API hooks and minimal console UI; run internal experiments on staging traffic (ENG + PM only).
Phase 1 (alpha customers): Invite 3 customers to opt into private experiments; collect real-world telemetry and iterate on instrumentation.
Phase 2 (beta): Expose full UI with gating controls for all Dedicated customers; allow opt-in for hosted customers behind a feature flag.
Phase 3 (GA): General availability with default conservative gates and documented best practices; enable auto-promotion as an opt-in feature.
metrics_gates: Errors: candidate error-rate <= pinned error-rate + 0.05% (absolute) or 1.5x (relative), whichever is stricter.
Quality: weighted eval score delta >= -0.02 (i.e., candidate must not drop more than 2% on configured prompt set unless explicitly accepted).
Cost: candidate cost-per-token deviation <= +15% (customers can opt to ignore cost gates).
Traffic Safety: initial traffic capped at 0.1% for first 24 hours for GA rollout unless explicitly overridden.
console_changes: New 'Pinned Experiments' tab under Model Pins that lists active experiments and historical runs.
Experiment creation flow: select pin -> choose candidate revision(s) -> set allocation curve (ramp up schedule) -> attach eval prompt set -> set gates and notification hooks.
Per-experiment dashboard: realtime traffic split, variant metrics, gate status, and a side-by-side example output diff viewer with sampling controls.
Quick actions: pause, increase allocation, promote (manual), enable auto-promotion, and force-rollback. All actions require 2-step confirm when traffic >5%.
api_changes: POST /pins/{pin_id}/experiments to create an experiment payload (candidate_revision_ids, initial_allocation, ramp_schedule, gate_config, eval_prompt_set_id).
GET /pins/{pin_id}/experiments/{exp_id} returns experiment state and metrics summary.
POST /pins/{pin_id}/experiments/{exp_id}/actions with actions=[start,pause,promote,rollback] and optional operator metadata for audit logs.
Webhooks for gate events and final promotion/rollback outcomes so customers can integrate with CI/alerting.
